description: The plot illustrates the loss over training time for a language model, comparing two different methods. The x-axis represents the training time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents the loss, with values ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot features two lines: one marked with a purple triangle and a dashed line style, and the other marked with a red circle and a solid line style. Both lines start at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decrease as training time increases, with the purple line consistently below the red line throughout the plot. At the end of the training time, the purple line is at a loss of around 2.45, while the red line is at approximately 2.50. A green dashed line at the end of the plot indicates that the purple line is 1.26 times more efficient than the red line in terms of loss.
